Parse Pipe-Delimited SLURM sacct Accounting Output

Source: R/backend_ssh.R
parse_sacct_output.Rd

Parses sacct -n -P --format=JobID,State,Elapsed,MaxRSS,ExitCode output into a tidy per-chunk tibble. Automatically consolidates .batch sub-step MaxRSS onto the parent array task row (e.g. 12345_2.batch merged into 12345_2) and ignores .extern overhead steps.

Usage

parse_sacct_output(stdout)

Arguments

stdout

Character scalar or vector captured from sacct.

Value

A tibble::tibble() with columns slurm_job_id, chunk_id, state, elapsed_sec, peak_rss_mb, and exit_code.

Examples

sample_out <- paste(
  "12345_1|COMPLETED|00:04:12||0:0",
  "12345_1.batch|COMPLETED|00:04:12|512000K|0:0",
  "12345_2|OUT_OF_MEMORY|00:01:05||0:125",
  sep = "\n"
)
parse_sacct_output(sample_out)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   slurm_job_id chunk_id state         elapsed_sec peak_rss_mb exit_code
#>   <chr>           <int> <chr>               <dbl>       <dbl>     <int>
#> 1 12345               1 COMPLETED             252         500         0
#> 2 12345               2 OUT_OF_MEMORY          65          NA         0
